XM-Games keeps the procedural abilities, character animation, targeting,
post-processing, and editor from upstream. The local integration adds an
isolated Theme Four build target, room lifecycle handoff, offline packaging,
mobile ability-bar sizing, product branding, and a hidden-by-default editor.
